units.summary: New test injects an append via a hook between block write and eviction, then checks the late sample survives eviction and WAL replay. Expectations differ by isolation mode. It covers the new watermark guard; it does not change production code.
units.headline: Test: late append during selected-series compaction survives restart
units.reason: New test only; cannot affect production behavior and adds coverage for the watermark guard.

units.summary: New test opens an appender before compaction and commits it in the pre-evict hook, then checks the series is retained and the sample survives restart. It is skipped when isolation is disabled.
units.headline: Test: pre-opened appender committing mid-compaction is not lost
units.reason: New test only; no production behavior change.

units.summary: Adds a small predicate returning true when a series has no out-of-order state. It is used as an eviction and selection filter in selected-series and stale-series compaction.
units.headline: Add predicate for series without out-of-order data
units.reason: Trivial predicate; its effect depends on callers, which are reviewed in their own units.

units.summary: Extracts the existing stale-NaN check on lastValue and the last histogram sums into a helper. The condition is identical to the inline check it replaces in gcSeries.
units.headline: Extract stale-series check into helper
units.reason: Same boolean expression as the removed inline code in gcStaleSeries, now reused.

units.summary: Stale-series truncation now delegates to truncateSeries and takes an appendID watermark. A series is evicted only if it has no OOO data, is still stale, and has no sample appended after the watermark. This stops stale-head compaction from dropping samples committed during the block write.
units.headline: Stale truncation skips series appended after the watermark
units.reason: Changes eviction conditions and signature; data-loss-sensitive concurrency logic.
focus: Watermark is captured before the block write and not later than the head view
Behavior when isolation is disabled, where the guard is a no-op
Skipped stale series are retried on later cycles and not leaked

units.summary: New eviction entry point for caller-chosen series. It skips series with OOO data or with samples whose appendID is above the watermark, and writes WAL tombstones only for the ones actually deleted. Used by CompactSelectedSeries after block write.
units.headline: Add selected-series eviction guarded by OOO and watermark
units.reason: New eviction logic that deletes head series and writes WAL tombstones; a wrong predicate loses data.
focus: Watermark is based on committed IDs, so appenders opened before capture but committed later are covered
Eviction of non-stale series cannot drop samples newer than the written block
Behavior with isolation disabled, where concurrent writes to selected series are unprotected

units.summary: New helper that walks a series' in-memory isolation transaction ring and reports whether any sample's appendID exceeds the watermark. It returns false when isolation is disabled. It lets eviction skip series that got samples after the block write started.
units.headline: Add check for samples appended past the compaction watermark
units.reason: Concurrency-sensitive ring iteration that decides whether data is evicted.
focus: Iteration over txs ring uses the right start and count, including after wraparound
Caller holds s.Lock as the comment requires
Ring entries cleaned up by isolation GC cannot hide a post-watermark sample
